iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear diplomacy remains active: Kazakhstan offered to take Iran uranium stockpile and US peace draft/sanctions-relief reporting continues, while declared 60 percent enrichment remains the standing technical risk. iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: US-Iran fighting remains active while officials report they are close to an arrangement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Merchant traffic disruption and renewed US strikes keep Hormuz restricted conditions, oil infrastructure risk, and regional force posture active; diplomacy is active but not yet a durable off-ramp.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon risk rose: Israel hit Beirut, reporting describes extensive strikes despite the truce framework, and Israeli forces reportedly crossed a key Lebanon river in an expanded ground offensive. Talks remain active, but truce breakdown and force expansion dominate.

turkey.name: TURKEY / EAST MED
turkey.notes: Fresh Turkey/East Mediterranean scan found only background Greece-US alignment reporting. No Turkish atomic warning, weapons demonstration, direct interstate clash, or mobilization surge surfaced.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan risk ticked up on fresh IISS/twin-front militarized-border reporting and an Indian Army chief warning, while political fallout from Pakistan-isolation efforts continues. No fresh cross-border strike trigger surfaced.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO risk remains driven by Oreshnik and official nuclear-rhetoric signaling in Russian warning coverage. No direct NATO-Russia kinetic exchange confirmed.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China/Taiwan scan did not surface a fresh blockade, live-fire surge, or Taiwan Strait crisis trigger; recent limited air/naval activity is carried as background rather than a new escalation signal.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea missile-development signal persists from recent short-range and cruise missile system tests, including new launch-system reporting. No device event reported.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine/NATO spillover remains the top driver: NATO condemned reckless Russian behavior after a drone strike in Romania injured civilians, with reports of NATO jets scrambled. Strategic nuclear rhetoric remains active through Russia warning/Oreshnik coverage.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan risk rose sharply: reporting says Pakistan is pushing war deeper into Afghanistan and Afghan Taliban sources report Pakistani air strikes causing casualties. Russia/China mediation channels are active, but force-use risk is now critical.

sudan.name: SUDAN / RED SEA SPILLOVER
sudan.notes: Sudanese army counter-offensive toward a strategic Ethiopian-border city indicates continued military buildup; infrastructure strike and external backing risks remain active around the wider Red Sea spillover channel.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE / GAZA
israel_palestine.notes: Netanyahu ordered the army to seize 70% of Gaza, violating ceasefire deal according to fresh reporting; ground force expansion and peace talk rupture risk push this zone into imminent.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: No fresh Abyei/South Sudan clash trigger surfaced in the 24h scan; residual instability remains elevated but not critical.
